ImageDescription.value: The Maritime Museum of the Atlantic on the Halifax Harbour waterfront in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada. Seen from the west, the image shows the museum buildings in the foreground on Lower Water Street with the museum wharves in the background including the museum's 100 year old steamship CSS Acadia in the centre. Three of the museum's small boat collection can be seen to the left of Acadia. On the right is HMCS Sackville, a restored WW II corvette, not part of the museum but a neighbour during the summer months. The harbour tour boat Mar can be seen on the water in the distance while a Canadian Navy RIB speedboat buzzes around the stern of Sackville.
